name: dover uuid job link yields apply-path ident
spec_quote: dover: `app.dover.com/apply/<name>/<job uuid>` or `app.dover.com/<name>/careers/<client uuid>` (also `app.dover.io`; uuid = 8-4-4-4-12 lower-case hex) → ident = the path from "apply/" or from "<name>/" up to and including the uuid, lower-cased ("apply/diffuse%20bio/1dabee06-…", "dover/careers/545c34b3-…").

name: dover client uuid careers link yields name/careers ident
spec_quote: dover: ... ident = the path from "apply/" or from "<name>/" up to and including the uuid, lower-cased ("apply/diffuse%20bio/1dabee06-…", "dover/careers/545c34b3-…").

name: dover apply link with bare slug only
spec_quote: An `app.dover.com/apply/<slug>` link with no uuid after it → ident = the slug alone (recorded, not searched). A uuid link never also yields the bare-slug hit.
ambiguous_reason: "the slug alone" could mean "acme" or the truncated path "apply/acme"; both readings are consistent with the wording, so the exact expected string is uncertain ("acme" assumed here).

name: paycom clientkey after other query keys with & entity
spec_quote: paycom: `paycomonline.net/v4/ats/web.php/jobs?clientkey=<32 hex>` (other query keys may come before it, joined with "&", "&" or "&") → ident = that whole text from "paycomonline.net" to the end of the key, lower-cased.

name: taleo Business Edition URL with org and cws
spec_quote: taleo Business Edition: `<x>.tbe.taleo.net/<dir>/ats/careers/…?…org=<ORG>` with an optional `&cws=<digits>` right after → ident = that text lower-cased.

name: taleo TBE link without cws never yields bare tbe.taleo.net
spec_quote: taleo Business Edition: `<x>.tbe.taleo.net/<dir>/ats/careers/…?…org=<ORG>` with an optional `&cws=<digits>` right after → ident = that text lower-cased. A Business Edition URL never yields the bare host "tbe.taleo.net".

name: successfactors career host with mixed-case company id
spec_quote: successfactors: `career<digits?>[preview].successfactors.com|.eu|sapsf.com|sapsf.eu/career?…company=<id>` → ident = host lower-cased + "/career?…company=<id>" with the id's case KEPT (the id is case-sensitive). The plain host hit is also returned as before.
ambiguous_reason: The spec says the plain host hit is also returned, but does not state the ordering of the two returned entries; both entries are expected here with the career? URL first.

name: clean_ident dover apply link to job uuid
spec_quote: dover: "apply/<name>/<uuid>" → "job/<uuid>"; "<name>/careers/<uuid>" → "client/<uuid>"; anything else (a bare slug) → null.

name: clean_ident dover client link
spec_quote: dover: "apply/<name>/<uuid>" → "job/<uuid>"; "<name>/careers/<uuid>" → "client/<uuid>"; anything else (a bare slug) → null.

name: clean_ident dover bare slug rejected
spec_quote: dover: "apply/<name>/<uuid>" → "job/<uuid>"; "<name>/careers/<uuid>" → "client/<uuid>"; anything else (a bare slug) → null.

name: clean_ident paycom clientkey with & entity decoded
spec_quote: paycom: besides `/portal/<32 hex>` and `/jobs/<32 hex>` at the end, an ident with `/jobs?…clientkey=<32 hex>` (entities "&" / "&" decoded, key followed by a non-hex character or the end) → the 32-hex key lower-cased.

name: clean_ident taleo bare tbe host rejected
spec_quote: taleo: a Business Edition ident → tbe_ident(); a bare "tbe.taleo.net" or any `.tbe.taleo.net` ident tbe_ident() rejects → null. Enterprise hosts (`<x>.taleo.net`) unchanged.

name: clean_ident successfactors drops extra query keys, keeps id case
spec_quote: successfactors: an ident `<career host>/career?…company=<id>` → "<host lower-cased>/career?company=<id>" (id case kept, other query keys dropped); any other ident → its host only (the part before the first "/", lower-cased; "@site" dropped).

name: clean_ident successfactors plain host with @site
spec_quote: successfactors: ... any other ident → its host only (the part before the first "/", lower-cased; "@site" dropped).

name: tbe_ident builds host/dir/ORG/cws
spec_quote: HTML entities decoded twice; host must be `<label>.tbe.taleo.net`; first path segment = dir (word characters / dashes); query key `org` (letters, digits, "_", "-") required; `cws` digits, default "1" (non-digit → "1"). → "<host>/<dir lower>/<ORG upper>/<cws>".

name: tbe_ident non-digit cws defaults to 1
spec_quote: `cws` digits, default "1" (non-digit → "1").

name: site_hosts keeps a single-label jobs2web company host first
spec_quote: The ident's own host (part before "@" and before the first "/", lower-cased) comes first when it is a company career host, then career_hosts(site); no duplicates. Own host is NOT used when: ... it is a `*.jobs2web.com` host with more than one label before "jobs2web.com" or whose label is vendor infrastructure (www, cdn, api, app, careers, jobs, rmkcdn …).

name: site_hosts excludes vendor successfactors host
spec_quote: Own host is NOT used when: ... it ends in a vendor domain (successfactors.com / .eu, sapsf.com / .eu, jobs.sap.com, phenompeople.com).

name: site_hosts dedupes own career host against career_hosts
spec_quote: The ident's own host (part before "@" and before the first "/", lower-cased) comes first when it is a company career host, then career_hosts(site); no duplicates.

name: site_hosts drops bare company root domain
spec_quote: Own host is NOT used when: ... it is the company's root domain or "www." + root domain.

name: parse_tbe reads title, link and location lines, dropping digit-only divs
spec_quote: title = link text (tags removed), url = href (entities decoded; kept only when it starts with https://; each url once), location = the non-empty div texts that are not all digits, joined ", " ("Houston", "US-TX", "77095" → "Houston, US-TX").

name: parse_tbe same url once and http link skipped
spec_quote: url = href (entities decoded; kept only when it starts with https://; each url once).

name: parse_dover url-quotes name, joins locations without duplicates
spec_quote: d.results[] objects with id and title; skipped when is_published is false or is_sample is true. url = `https://app.dover.com/apply/<name URL-quoted (spaces → %20)>/<id>` ("company" when name is empty); location = each location's `name` (else location_option.display_name), empty ones dropped, duplicates once, joined "; ".

name: parse_dover skips unpublished and sample jobs, empty name becomes company
spec_quote: skipped when is_published is false or is_sample is true. url = `https://app.dover.com/apply/<name URL-quoted (spaces → %20)>/<id>` ("company" when name is empty); location = each location's `name` (else location_option.display_name).

name: parse_rmk site-coded job link with id-based location fallback
spec_quote: Job links may be `/job/…/<digits>/` or `/<site code>/job/…/<digits>/` (one extra path segment). Location: the `class="jobLocation…"` text as before, else the text of the element whose id ends in `-section-location-value`.

name: rmk_site detects RMK page by two markers
spec_quote: A page that is itself an RMK career site → [["successfactors", <url host lower-cased>]]. Markers (case-insensitive): "ssoCompanyId", "j2w.init", "var j2w", "jobs2web.com", "rmkcdn.successfactors.com". Needs at least two DIFFERENT markers, one of them "ssoCompanyId" or "j2w.init".

name: rmk_site returns [] on a vendor jobs2web host
spec_quote: [] when the host is a vendor host (see site_hosts), the url has no host, or the markers are missing.

name: inventory_hints keeps live boards in list order and drops rejected idents
spec_quote: Every hint (first 8 from the company list) is kept only when a live check says its board lists something now: ... any other system ats_search reads (iCIMS, Oracle Cloud, Taleo incl. Business Edition, ...) → ats_search.live(system, ident) is true. A hint whose ident clean_ident rejects, or of a system ats_search does not read, is dropped without a request. Order of the kept hints = list order.

name: inventory_hints drops a hint whose live check is false
spec_quote: Every hint (first 8 from the company list) is kept only when a live check says its board lists something now: ... A hint whose ident clean_ident rejects, or of a system ats_search does not read, is dropped without a request. Order of the kept hints = list order.

name: live returns false and never raises when requests fail
spec_quote: ats_search.live(system, ident) → bool: False without any request when the system is not one ats_search reads, the ident is not a string, or clean_ident rejects it. (Here the ident is accepted, so the harness's failing request must surface as False, not an exception.)
